title: India just cut a 10-hour drive down to 6 - with a 594-kilometre expressway
sources: India TV News - Meerut to Prayagraj in 6 hours via Ganga Expressway through 12 districts
Indian Infrastructure - Ganga Expressway worth Rs 36,230 crore gets inaugurated
caption:
India just cut a 10-hour drive down to 6. With a 594-kilometre expressway through 12 districts.

The Ganga Expressway, a six-lane greenfield highway linking Meerut to Prayagraj, was inaugurated April 29, 2026, cutting travel time from roughly 10-12 hours to about 6. Built at a cost of roughly Rs 36,230 crore, it's Uttar Pradesh's longest expressway and India's second-longest after the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway. It includes a 3.5 km stretch near Shahjahanpur built as an emergency Indian Air Force airstrip.

Most new highways just move cars faster. This one also doubles as a runway when the country needs it to.
